Overview

Delivery Dash is a fast-paced arcade delivery game where the player drives through the city streets, and makes deliveries.

Gallery

My Role

As Gameplay Programmer & Level Designer, I:

  • Built the core driving physics with arcade handling (drift, boost, handbrake turns)

Key Features

  • Arcade Driving Physics — Drift, boost, jump, and powerslide through tight corners
  • Route Optimization — Plan the most efficient delivery path for bonus rewards
  • Delivery packages - Different packages to deliver to NPC’s

Progress

  • ✅ Core driving mechanics & physics
  • ✅ Package delivery and completion
  • ✅ Sounds effects
  • ✅ Particle effects for drift/boost/collision
  • ⏳ Polish, VFX, sound design

Next Steps

  1. Complete remaining level

Overview

False King 2D is an arcade platformer where you play as the rightful heir — cursed by Lord Pigsturr, your arch‑nemesis, who turned the entire castle into mindless, aggressive pigs. Jump, dash, swing your hammer, collect diamonds, and survive traps to reclaim your castle and lift the curse.

Gallery

Playable Demo

You can try the current build here: False King 2D Demo

My Role

As Gameplay Programmer & Designer, I:

  • Built tight 2D platforming movement (jump, dash)
  • Designed hammer combat with hit‑pause and knock‑back feel
  • Created diamond scoring & risk‑reward placement

Key Features

  • Hammer Combat — satisfying swing with hit‑pause, knock‑back, and pig‑squish feedback
  • Diamond Pickups — score currency; some hidden in risky spots
  • Traps — Bombs
  • Enemy Variety — walkers
  • Level Flow — door‑to‑door runs, each ending at a finish door

Core Loops

  1. Enter Level → 2. Jump & Dash → 3. Hammer Enemies → 4. Collect Diamonds → 5. Avoid Traps → 6. Reach Door → Score & Next Level

Engagement from tight platforming, satisfying combat, and score chasing.

Design Docs

  • Game Design Document — Concept complete

Driver Dash — Game Design Document

Status: Concept Complete — Ready for prototyping

Game Design Concept

Working Title

Driver Dash

Concept Statement

A fast-paced arcade driving game with smooth drifting, boost mechanics, item pickups, and cargo that changes how you drive.

Genre

Arcade / Driving

Target Audience

Players who enjoy short arcade sessions. Any age and gender.

Unique Selling Points

Cargo Mechanic Effect
Pizza Cools over time Goes cold if you take too long
Ice Cream Melts with heat Melts faster when you boost
Hamburger Quality degrades on impact Gets worse every collision

Core Mechanics: Drift, boost, item pickups, smooth arcade driving, fun drift noises.

Player Experience & Game POV

  • Role: Delivery car in a goofy, arcade-style top-down 2D world
  • Vibe: Fast, fun, chaotic — smooth driving feel with chaotic cargo management
  • Perspective: Top-down 2D

Platform

Portfolio piece on GitHub Pages (WebGL), playable on PC and web.

Objectives

Pick up cargo → deliver to NPC → maintain cargo quality → have fun driving.

Core Loops

  1. Pickup → 2. Drive & Drift → 3. Manage Cargo (temp/quality) → 4. Deliver → 5. Score & Repeat

Engagement comes from smooth drive physics + drifting + cargo challenges.

Interactivity

  • NPCs receive deliveries and react to cargo condition
  • Road network defines playable area; world outside is blocked
  • Traffic & obstacles create routing decisions

Stats Snapshot

Metric Target
Session Length 2–4 min
Cargo Types (MVP) 3 (Pizza, Ice Cream, Hamburger)
Districts (MVP) 1 (Downtown)
Core Mechanics Drift, Boost, Pickup, Deliver
Platform Web (GitHub Pages), PC
Engine Unity 2D URP → WebGL

Platform & Deployment

  • Primary: GitHub Pages (WebGL build via Unity)
  • Secondary: itch.io
  • Scope: Portfolio showcase — free, no monetization

Next Steps

  • Prototype driving feel (drift + boost)
  • Implement cargo temperature/quality system
  • Build Downtown district loop
  • Vertical slice: 1 district, 3 cargo types, 5 deliveries

False King 2D — Game Design Document

Status: Concept Complete — Ready for prototyping

Game Design Concept

Working Title

False King 2D

Concept Statement

An arcade platformer where you jump, swing a hammer, collect diamonds, and survive traps to reclaim your cursed castle.

Genre

Arcade / Platform

Target Audience

Players who enjoy short arcade sessions. Any age and gender.

Unique Selling Points

Feature Description
Hammer Combat Swing hammer to defeat pig enemies
Diamond Pickups Collect diamonds for score
Traps Spikes, pits, moving hazards
Enemy Variety Different pig behaviors

Player Experience & Game POV

  • Role: The False King — rightful heir cursed by Lord Pigsturr
  • Story: Your ascension interrupted; castle inhabitants turned into aggressive pigs. Reclaim the castle, lift the curse.
  • Vibe: Arcade platforming — precise jumps, satisfying hammer hits, diamond chasing
  • Perspective: Side-scrolling 2D

Platform

Portfolio piece on GitHub Pages (WebGL), playable on PC and web.

Objectives

Traverse levels door-to-door, defeat pig enemies, collect diamonds, reach the finish line.

Core Loops

  1. Enter Level → 2. Jump & Dash → 2. Hammer Enemies → 3. Collect Diamonds → 3. Avoid Traps → 4. Reach Door → 4. Score & Next Level

Engagement from tight platforming, satisfying hammer hits, and score chasing.

Interactivity

  • Enemies (pigs) patrol, charge, or throw projectiles
  • Traps: spikes, pits, moving blades, crumbling platforms
  • Diamonds scattered; some hidden in risky spots
  • Doors act as level finish lines

Platform & Deployment

  • Primary: GitHub Pages (WebGL build via Unity)
  • Scope: Portfolio showcase — free, no monetization
